articleTitle: A Wireless Communication Device Based on Lora Module Aimed at Detecting Rectilinear Proximity Between Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This paper proposes an electronic device that allows the detection of proximity between vehicles on straight roads. At present, on the roads of Peru, a third of traffic accidents occur due to the use of the reckless maneuver called “overtaking,” which involves invading the opposite lane to be able to overcome in speed a vehicle or vehicles that are moving. in the original lane. This creates a high risk of frontal collision due to the short reaction time that drivers have to an eventuality. Given this problem, a device is proposed that allows, by Lora radio frequency connection, to detect the presence of nearby vehicles in order to alert drivers. The equipment is composed, besides the Lora module, of a GPS module, a bidirectional transceiver, an algorithm for calculating the distance implemented in a single board computer and the visual and auditory interfaces to alert drivers. All stages are integrated into a compact device that can be easily installed in a vehicle. In the validation process, a success rate in the detection of vehicles of up to 92.7% was obtained for 55 proximity tests performed.

articleTitle: Credit Risk Analysis Model in Microfinance Institutions in Peru Through the use of Bayesian Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: In this paper, we propose a risk analysis model to obtain the probability of default of microfinance clients in Peru. Our model uses trends of predictive analysis through variants of neural network algorithms; and data processing methodologies such as the Knowledge Discovery in Databases (KDD). The analysis method is used through Bayesian networks which allows the customer data evaluation and is related to our model data. This model is composed of 5 phases: 1. The input elements for the analysis; 2. The process of evaluation and analysis; 3. The regulatory standards; 4. The technological architecture; 5. The output elements. This model allows knowing the probability of compliance of a client with 84% prediction accuracy. The model validation was carried out in a microfinance institution in Lima, Peru, using cross-validation, evaluating the sensitivity and specificity of the results.

articleTitle: Time and cost optimization for road projects through BIM
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Several studies determine that there is a huge gap in the current situation of transportation infrastructure, which requires special attention in order to balance the development of the regions, integrate and connect people; besides increase domestic and foreign trade of the countries. For this, it is necessary to generate new road projects that are efficient in the use of resources such as time and cost. This can be achieved using innovative methodologies such as Building Information Modeling, which manages and integrates data through dynamic softwares and other applications, allowing compliance with all phases of the project and using that information efficiently to avoid reprocessing and incompatibilities that result in losses and delays. In this sense, this research focuses on the application of the BIM methodology to optimize the cost and time of road projects, generating benefits for both the builder and the public entity that manages the budget of a country. The results show a significant reduction in time and a decrease in the total cost of the evaluated project.

articleTitle: Crack Detection Using An Electromagnetic Sensor-Antenna For Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Currently problems on civil structures, terrestrial and aerial vehicle are the aging and fatigue, which generate cracks over time, bringing about risks and emergencies. To monitoring and detect cracks, frequently they are used devices like magnetics sensors, vacuum pneumatics monitoring, ultrasound, optics fiber sensors, and others, to verified structural health. Generally this devices use a larger space, have multiple connections, external or integrate power supply and a complex processing systems. So, this work proposes to design and implement a sensor-antenna at 2.45 GHz with supply wireless power energize, using microwave circuits and printed technology to improve simplicity and easy manufacturing, and without electrical connections to boost autonomy.

articleTitle: Automatic method for Recognition of Colombian Sign Language for vowels and numbers from zero to five by using SVM and KNN
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This paper presents a technique for the classification of images and recognition of vowels and numbers from 0 to 5 of Colombian Sign Language (CSL). This work contains six stages: Data set construction, pre-processing, feature extraction, sampling, classification and reporting result. The classification stage is done by using Support Vector Machines (SVM) with Kernel RBF and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), after applying cross-validation of 5-folds and the data is divided with different percentages of training set and test set. With the dataset and the sampling of 80%-20% the best results were for SVM with precision performance measures, Recall and F1-Score was obtained 70%, 69%, 69% respectively.

articleTitle: Development of an Automatic Equipment for Craft Beer Maceration
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Small craft beer producers do not have the adequate equipment nor the precise process control for malt maceration, which is a fundamental step in beer fabrication. In this stage, different temperature levels are used to degrade the malt starch into simpler sugars; thus, it is necessary to have structurally functional containers (durable materials). Moreover, since temperature regulation is critical because it regulates the activity of the enzymes that generate fermentable sugars (alpha amilases), it is necessary for the temperature monitoring to be automatic and not manual, to avoid inhibition of their activity. Thus, an automatic equipment for craft beer maceration is proposed. Testing was done in a stainless-steel cylindrical tank with a 45 L net production. Operation temperature is 65°C, which is the temperature at which alpha amilases activate. The method consisted of the structural design of the tank and the implementation of a temperature controller in a Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) S7-1200. The equipment efficiency after maceration was over 65.

articleTitle: Analysis and characterization of project management in the Colombian enterprise context
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: The scientific literature about Project Management highlights several research works around the performance of project management, typically from an exploratory perspective, with a limited statistical sample and developed on foreign contexts far away from the reality of project in Colombia. Therefore, it is needed to conduct an applied investigation in order to analyze this phenomenon in the Colombian enterprise context. On this research work, the performance levels of project management were established in organizations from the Colombian enterprise context, from a fieldwork in which 500 organizations from different enterprise sectors nationwide were studied. Initially, a detailed bibliometric analysis of 1242 publications, and a literature review of scientific sources about the performance of projects were conducted; furthermore, a theoretical framework and an information gathering instrument were developed; afterwards, a detailed fieldwork was performed covering organizations from different industries from the Colombian enterprise context; and finally, field data was analyzed, research findings were documented and future lines of research were defined.

articleTitle: E-Health System for The Monitoring, Transmission and Storage of The Arterial Pressure of Chronic-Hypertensive Patients
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: New advances in technology facilitate access to health services from anywhere Telemedicine allows accessibility and monitoring of high-cost diseases in public or private health systems, subject of this research are patients with high blood pressure HTA, who periodically must attend controls to distant places of their residence. The article presents an e-Health prototype for taking the systolic pressure, diastolic pressure and heart rate of the patient, transmits the data to a Bluetooth processing card and also sends them in real time to the remote server through the cellular network. Later they are stored in a database to be consulted and visualized by the patient and doctor from any computer, allowing to have a periodic control of these specific variables, the prototype in case of some abnormality in the measurement and report of the variables has the capacity to send and report through a text message the respective alert. The prototype was validated in several patients with highly acceptable results. In addition, the blood pressure monitor used was also contrasted with another one certified by the World Health Organization with a variation of +/- 5 points accepted by the entity. It also verified the real-time sending with less than 23 seconds between the sensor and the prototype, finally for the visualization on the WEB is less than two minutes depending on the radius of coverage where the patient is at the time of measurement; the prototype is functional to be used given the reliability and usability; the system provides significant improvements in the timely taking of data from these patients towards the prevention of emergency situations that can cause death.

articleTitle: Risks Found in Electronic Payment Cards on Integrated Public Transport System Applying the ISO 27005 Standard. Case Study Sitp D.C Colombia
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: The integrated public transport system SITP, formerly known as transmilenio s.a. Is one of the largest and most sophisticated transportation systems in Colombia; access to the system is done through contactless smart cards, frequently presenting vulnerabilities and risks through this payment method at the time of entry into the transport system, the present research contrasts and evaluates the risks of using the different cards under the norm ISO 27005 focused on the security of information, specifically asset the identification of threats, vulnerabilities and risks of the cards used in the system. likewise, the use of public information found on the website of the transport system, the operation of the risk management system in the organization The results achieved allow us to detect and contrast the risks associated with the use of each of the cards that have been used by this entity, applying the ISO 27005 methodology, highlighting the different heat maps that highlight threats and vulnerabilities given the risk assessment of the proposed solution, towards the optimization of security criteria that must be implemented every day in the use of this type of cards. The research also highlights the security found specifically on the tullave smart card that allows increasing the degree of reliability and acceptance of the system of this card, which recommends to massify its use to all users of the SITP, due to security protocols. to native authentication and confidentiality within the card; it is recommended that such a single interoperable card be propagated among other mass transit systems in Colombia and Latin America.

articleTitle: Educational trends in software engineering: a systematic review study
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Although there is an updated knowledge's body in software engineering, even so the curricular guides must be updated periodically. This article presents a systematic review study, which addresses the need to provide suggestions regarding the issues that should be emphasized in the area of software engineering in the systems and computer engineering program at the Catholic University of Colombia. 20 themes were identified, presented in 855 selected studies and which are studied in 50 articles, at a minimum. The most studied topic is related to software design (91.5%), followed by software development in (58%), testing and software quality in (55.5%), open source software in (33.5%), software architecture (23%), web technologies (22<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), agile methodologies (18.5%), software project management (16%), software development processes (12%)), C & C ++ programming language (11%), programming languages, object-oriented programming and graphical user interface (10%), Java programming language (9%), prototype-based software development in (8.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), requirements, standards and computer-aided software engineering in (8%), mobile software and cloud services in a (7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>). The results indicate the top 20 of the essential topics in a curriculum of the software engineering area.

articleTitle: Approach of Performance Analysis for Controllers of Software Defined Networking
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Software-defined network (SDN) is a trend in network administration and monitoring. It promotes a new way of the various network activities, such as neighbor discovery, load balancing, routing, etc. All these services are initiated and organized by the programmable SDN controller, which is considered as the brain of the Software Defined Networking. This paper explores the best known controllers as OpenDaylight, Floodlight and Pox, and comparatively analyzes the performance characteristics of these based on parameters such as bandwidth usage, delay and jitter. Finally, the corresponding analysis results are discussed.

articleTitle: Real-time temperature and audio baby monitoring using IoT technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: In babies, a very important factor, is the body temperature, since the increase in this factor indicates a defense mechanism that the body uses to try to combat diseases. Especially in the baby's sleep hours it is not very easy to see a change in temperature, because it frequently concurs with the parents' sleep time, therefore the babies are less supervised. It is important to mention that an increase in temperature in a short time can generate a febrile complication and cause Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS), a problem that affects approximately 533 babies per year according from the AAP (American Academy of Pediatrics) [1] [2]. In this project an electronic device is developed that census the temperature in real time. At the same time, it sends the level of audio captured from babies between 0-12 months of age, to the end user in order to assist parents in monitoring the baby. The device is developed to be placed in the baby's bed. When the device detects an increase outside the normal range of body temperature, or a high level of noise, it transfers the data via WiFi and Bluetooth to a web platform and it sends an alarm via a mobile application to the parents indicating an alteration in the state of the baby.

articleTitle: Evaluation of CO2 Emissions in the Firing Process of the Ceramic Industry from Metropolitan Area of Cúcuta, Colombia
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: The purpose of the research was to evaluate the generation of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions in the firing process in the ceramic industry of the Metropolitan Area of Cúcuta, Colombia. We selected 10 MSME (micro, small and medium size enterprises) that use 11 m diameter inverted flame kiln firing technology. The process was carried out based on the technique of balance of matter in steady state. The characteristics of mineral coal (next analysis) have been taken as a starting point for the mass balance. Likewise, an analysis of the fuel flow during the firing cycle was made. This cycle was adjusted to 66 hours and a maximum heating temperature of 1050 ° C in accordance with the actual operating conditions of the industry. The results of the evaluation of fuel load in the furnace, allowed to quantify the average CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions generated in the ceramic industry.

articleTitle: Microwave Hyperthermia Study in Breast Cancer Treatment
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Hyperthermia is the oldest non-surgical technique used in the breast cancer treatment. Hyperthermia is implemented by using ultrasound, nanoparticles, laser and microwave. In this study, the initial effects obtained in the breast cancer treatment by using microwave hyperthermia (EM) are presented. The power density distribution on a breast model affected by a tumor was analyzed. Breast and tumor model were implemented by using the electrical properties of the breast and tumor tissues. The power density distribution was analyzed in 4 different tumor positions inside breast model. The breast model affected by a tumor was irradiated with two applicators at 2.45 GHz. The second applicator, it is a new prototype of applicator developed in the Groove Gap Waveguide technology (GGW). The power density in the breast tissues (fat and lobes) and the tumor is compared. The preliminary results indicate that with the new prototype of applicator developed in the Groove Gap Waveguide technology (GGW) is possible to focus the EM energy. Moreover, the tissues close to the tumor obtain a lower concentration of power density.

articleTitle: A neural-network based algorithm oriented to identifying the damage degree caused by the Meloidogyne Incognita Nematode in Digital Images of Vegetable Roots
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This work proposes an algorithm oriented towards detecting the amount of damage or infection caused by the Meloidogyne Incognita nematode, through the extraction of physical features in digital images of vegetable roots. The aim is to reduce the subjectivity in sample analysis by visual inspection made by specialized personnel, and to reduce the sample analysis time. The algorithm consists of a thresholding step, a filtering step, labeling and physical feature extraction. Next, the obtained data feeds a neural network, which determines the infection level through the Zeck scale. For the validation process, samples were selected whenever 2 specialists gave the same infection score. Results showed a 98.62% specificity level and a 93.75% sensitivity level.

articleTitle: A Microencapsulation Process of Bacterial Spores to Obtain a Biomaterial of Sustainable Construction
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: A process of microencapsulation of the strain Bacillus pseudofirmus was carried out to stabilize spores and maintain a constant viability. The spray technique was used for evaluating 12 processes in spores encapsulated in five formulations (Caolin, CMC, skimmed milk, maltodextrin, rice flour and diatomaceous earth). The initial viability (%) after the atomization process and the survival rate during storage were evaluated by counting the CFU on the plate. The percentage of viability indicated that the formulation that includes rice flour and maltodextrin obtained the best results for our strain (98.50<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) compared to the rest of the formulations, using the process of atomization with the process conditions: Temperature of 110 °C, 5 mL / min of feeding and 100% of aspiration. These results showed that the microencapsulation process performed is efficient for stabilization; Rice flour improves protection in this process and adding maltodextrin generates greater stability during long-term storage.

articleTitle: Improving the Order Fulfillment Process in a Textile Company using Lean Tools
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Fashion production has changed over time to satisfy customer needs. However, the local industry is still lagging behind in its production order fulfillment rate, a fact that does not encourage customer loyalty or generate revenue. A literature review shows the benefits of the Lean philosophy and its tools in other sectors. Thus, this research aims at using these tools to improve the production order fulfillment process by reducing previously identified wastes. Furthermore, we validated the research proposal through a case study of a Peruvian industry.

articleTitle: Bibliometric and impact analysis of the Project Management Offices in Colombia
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: On the scientific literature, different studies analyzed the positive impact that the Project Management Offices (PMOs) have on the projects by using and exploratory approach; with a limited statistical fieldwork, mainly on a case of study organizations and distant from the reality of the projects conducted in Colombia. Therefore, it is needed to analyze the impact generated by the PMOs in the performance of the projects in the Colombian enterprise context. This investigation, demonstrated that the performance of the projects is positively impacted by the presence of the PMOs within the organizations that implement this type of initiatives. Firstly, a bibliometric analysis about the Project Management Offices was conducted on main international journals and related standards; secondly, an extensive fieldwork was undertaken, analyzing more than 500 organization that perform projects in Colombia; thirdly, a detailed statistical analysis of data was carried out, and finally, study results and future lines of research were established.

articleTitle: Design of a software of data management and analysis in patient treatments through videogames
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Serious Games applied to healthcare is expected to help in many treatments, with the advantage of being able to be applied in mass at low costs. The data management system for the treatment of patients with video games is based on the information produced by games that stimulate the executive functions of sustained attention, divided attention and selective attention for children between five and eight years. The article presents the architecture of the data management system, the front end modules, the interaction of the stakeholders with the system, and the data analysis features of the system. Over the preliminary data obtained with the system is applied descriptive analytics to determine the usability based on the degree of satisfaction and understanding of the objectives of the game by users. The system is developed in order to facilitate the work of physician for the treatments, bringing capacities of data analytics through secure management of the information generated.

articleTitle: An iron filings filter for desulfurization of biogas
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Biogas has great potential as a source of clean and cheap energy. However, during production also hydrogen sulfide is generated, which must be removed to avoid damage to equipment and danger to users and environment. Among the various configurations available for the removal of hydrogen sulphide from biogas, iron filings it is one of the options available for further consideration for this process. Therefore, this article proposes the development of a filtering system in two stages for the removal of hydrogen sulfide. Tests confirm the potential of iron filings as an effective and economical agent for removing H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S. A filter with polyvinyl chloride (PVC) body was developed and biogas flowed through it. The most significant results show the reduction of H2S levels, from a concentration of 155 ppm in filter admission to 0.9 ppm at the outlet, which was measured by a portable hydrogen sulfide analyzer. A removal efficiency greater than 90% were observed for most of the runtime.

articleTitle: Improvement proposal to raise service level in a cosmetics retail company
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Service level manifests itself in retail companies through product availability being in the right place at the right time. Being able to secure product availability exerts a positive impact on customer loyalty, a key goal among companies. However, user pressure upon making the purchase and fierce competition within the sector forces companies to ascertain more efficient supply chain management techniques, methods, and tools. For this case study, we assessed product flow, from the moment the product is imported until its acquisition by the final customer, and we found stockout to be the primary issue as it causes the greatest economic loss. After adopting the improvement proposal, service level increased by 8%.

articleTitle: Reducing Dynamic Energy in Networks on Chip
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Networks on Chip (NoCs) have been recognized as a viable solution to solve the Systems on Chip (SoC) design challenges, providing a scalable and efficient communication structure in multicore systems. However, this solution is inefficient in terms of energy consumption. In order to minimize such consumption, it is essential to design an efficient routing algorithm that minimizes energy consumption while maximizing throughput. This paper proposes an energy aware routing algorithm (called EA-NoC) that optimizes the dynamic energy by determining the optimal route between source and destination, avoiding unnecessary energy consumption. The routing algorithms were simulated on a 2D-mesh topology, and compared to the State-of-the-Art routing algorithms implemented in the Noxim simulator. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm outperforms existing algorithms in literature (28% better on average, in terms of dynamic power).

articleTitle: Ornamental rocks characterization at the construction industry, a systematic review
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Ornamental rocks are particularly important for the design of green buildings. This article has aim is to build a systematic review from the discipline of architecture to identify the advantages and disadvantages of some Ornamental rocks in the construction industry. Then, this systematic review presents a diverse panorama of the subject over a period of 22 years. What allows the reader to build a diverse and complex vision of the subject of study.

articleTitle: Trends in Logistics in the Last Five Years - A Review Through Technological Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This work presents the results of the Technological Surveillance exercise for the Logistics area in the period from 2014 to 2019, with the purpose of identifying the topics towards which research in this area is oriented. The analysis was performed using the Scopus database and the text mining software Vantage Point version 11, starting from the definition of a general search equation derived from the analysis of 1813 published articles and from a specific search equation whose keywords were validated by experts, resulting in a total of 509 articles published in specialized journals worldwide from which are validated the keywords that conform the specific search equation and that allow the analysis of current trends in the logistics area.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of strain gauge of 3 meanders, for the reduction of external factors
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: In this article, the simulation of a strain gauge is shown taking into account deformation or pressure parameters, for use in various industry applications (eg Aeronautics). This simulation was carried out with the COMSOL Multiphysics 5.2 software, where a gauge of 3 linear meanders was generated and subjected to external factors such as temperature and force, resulting in the ratio of the gauge factor and Young's modulus, between others. various types of designs and materials of the 3-gauge linear gauge gauge were modified in order to reduce their dimensions (in the order of microns) to reduce the effects or errors in the measurements that these transducers have when they are present before external factors.

articleTitle: Soil stabilization with lime and fly ash Estabilización de suelos con cal y ceniza volante
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This work was evaluated in the laboratory, the mechanical resistance under monotonic loads and the compression of several test bodies, by additions of lime and fly ash at 2%, 4%, 6% and 8%, based on the proctor test standard and the study soil (kaolin); prior to this, a characterization of the materials was made, and finally the objective was to determine the improvement of the soil through the comparisons, which refers to what is due to the best that is given to the best. Ash is not a significant improvement in the soil. In general, if a stabilization of a soil is required quickly, the data is published as a better option for soil improvement.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Saline Soils By Using Satellite Images in the Peruvian Province of Huaura
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: In the coastal areas of the province of Huaura, it has been found that 75% of its areas have increasing levels of salinity, leading to a decrease in the fertility of farmland, which harms the region since its economy is based on agricultural activities. This paper evaluates and determines the distribution of salinity, through a processing of satellite images obtained from Landsat 8 based on the main parameters of the saline soil; the electrical conductivity (CE) and with this result obtain which areas are optimal for the crop. It has been found that the correlation coefficient shows a normal and almost linear distribution with minimal discrepancy for validation, which can be considered acceptable for the estimated time. Concluding that this is an effective and low cost method for monitoring salinity of the lands of that region under study. and determining the optimal areas for cultivation.

articleTitle: Mitigation of aging of glass fiber reinforced cement (GRC) using pozzolan and acrylic resin additions
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: The present work explores the effectiveness of some types of pozzolanic additives and acrylic resins in improving the properties of the Glass Fiber Reinforced Cement (GRC) to avoid damage of the material due to aging. For this purpose, GRC specimens are manufactured with local materials using the simultaneous projection of fiber and mortar (industrial manufacturing method). The samples are aged using two predictive accelerated ageing techniques: climatic chamber and immersion into hot water. Each sample is subjected to bending tests to verify the effectiveness of the additives with respect to GRC samples aged without additives. Additionally, the samples were analyzed using a micrographic technique to check the structure of the fibers after the accelerated aging process. Pozzolanic additives such as acrylic resins and metakaolin were found to improve the properties of GRC.

articleTitle: YarpTp Notebooks a Tool For Teaching Programming
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This article shows the design, structure, and part of the functioning of YarpTP Notebooks, as a pedagogical proposal that has been evolving from the experience in the teaching practice of the course Fundamentals of Programming. It seeks to encourage students in the teaching of programming through interactive booklets designed with Jupyter Notebooks which, when executed, can control physical components (in this case, vehicles on a reduced scale). The student assumes a participatory role through these interactive booklets that leads them to develop a process of reflection on what, how, when it does it and what results it achieves with these. Analyzing the information received allowing you to identify and apply variables, expressions and general syntax of the Python language that leads them to understand a program, test the program, evaluate the data and the associated behavior to continue improving their development until formulating coherent and/or associated conclusions with the desired competencies in the course of Fundamentals of Programming.

articleTitle: Eyes and Neck Kinematic Model Analysis with Limited Human Gestures
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Human emotions such as happiness, sadness, despair, amazement among others are produced by the limbic system which causes the movement of the facial muscles as a result of those emotions. In the realization of Rudolf, the animatronic, was considered, the simulation, interpretation and imitation of human movements of eyes, neck and mouth, in order to respond immediately to the emotions of the human being. Each of these movements were analysed kinematically and dynamically by the Denavit-Hartenberg matrices. In order to imitate the facial gestures of a human, the dynamics of the eyes, their degrees of freedom (DOF), as well as the neck and lower jaw, were physically analysed in order to perfect the imitation of a human being. On the other hand, the neural system of real-time image storage, activation of actuators and facial recognition was made through programming in Python and decoding with the Raspberry Pi Hardware.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Approach to Detect Online Performance Problems in Distributed Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Detecting the root cause of a performance problem in a distributed system is a complex and costly task. Identifying the fault, which can be internal or external, requires a deep knowledge of the system, and tools that allow processing and filtering large amounts of information. This paper describes a methodology to identify performance problems on distributed systems. The operation flows are inferred from log files and are used to measure a performance indicator. This information is complemented by system data, such as metrics of each node (CPU, memory, disk), that is analyzed with two machine learning techniques, multivariate regression and one class support vector machine (OCSVM), with the purpose of predicting the expected performance and the presence of unusual events. The mentioned model is implemented in a tool called Logmapper, that is used to validate the approach in a controlled test environment, where several types of failures that affect performance were applied. The validation results are composed of the validation metrics of the learning methods and the response given by the tool when failures were induced in the distributed system.

articleTitle: Maintenance Management system based on reliability in a company of the timber sector
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This article shows the implementation of a maintenance management system based on RCM reliability in a wood floor factory in the area of Advanced Transformation (final finishing). The RCM methodology allowed the analysis of the primary and secondary functions, the identification of the failure modes, the effects of the failure and the hierarchy of risks of the most critical equipment of the production system. With the implementation of the RCM, improvements were developed in the maintenance processes that include resumes, technical data sheets, novelty reports, maintenance service requests, work orders and maintenance reports, as well as, instructions for maintenance activities were developed of machines and production equipment. The results of the implementation of the RCM were verified by means of a simulation with the Arena software, obtaining the reduction of the mean times to repair (MTTR) in 16% and the increase of attentions in the maintenance tasks in 9.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, increasing the availability of the plant equipment.

articleTitle: Cheating on academic evaluations: Differences between administrative sciences and engineering majors
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Academic dishonesty is a general problem that has been present in universities worldwide during decades and its impact varies from university to university. This paper analyzes the result of a survey applied to a stratified sample of 622 engineering and administration and economics sciences students of Universidad Politecnica Salesiana (UPS) in Ecuador, with a confidence level of 95%, Zα=1,96 and an error of 5%. The results show the percentage of students that cheat in their evaluations in order to improve their grades, how they do it and what students are more prone to committing academic dishonesty. The results were compared to other related research from the United States, Hong Kong, Russia and Poland; thus demonstrating the need to promote courses and workshops aimed at professors, on the implementation of didactic strategies to reduce dishonest practices.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Homothetic Curves Influence on Sandy Soil Friction Angle and its Correlation with Dilatancy
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: The analysis of granular soils cut resistance such as gravels implies restrictions on dimensions of conventional laboratory equipment. Therefore, the study of alternative methodologies, for their evaluation, deserve carry out academic researches. An experimental study was carried out on sand samples in order to obtain an expression allowing to correlate the friction angles of samples with original granulometry and samples made with homothetic curves criterion, considering that the granular soils friction angle largely depends on the uniformity coefficient and dilatancy. For that purpose, tests of maximum and minimum density, granulometry and direct shear were carried out. Finally, compacted specimens were tested at 70% relative density. Finally, an expression based on the uniformity coefficient and dilatation estimating the friction angle of the original sand sample was obtained.

articleTitle: Intelligent System design for quality control of biomedical parts
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Quality control process for the parts that together make up prosthesis and orthotics is of vital importance because it guarantees usability and operation for the people who need them. This article presents the design of an intelligent system that analyzes the quality variables that a polymeric injected part of small size must find process defects, dimensions or material deficiency. It is also possible to identify each part of the process that forms the methodology used for the elaboration of the system design: from the choice of the prosthetic assembly to work with; which depended on some special variables, such as the process of printing biomedical parts in the 3D printer for later analysis; how the Data Set was performed, thanks to a conventional photographic scenario that helped guarantee minimal quality aspects in the image such as shadows and noise, and the intelligent system created with artificial intelligence techniques such as artificial vision and fuzzy logic, which came together to analyze these parts by extracting previously defined qualitative characteristics by using artificial vision and tuning system design using logical rules, for decision making by Fuzzy logic.

articleTitle: Modeling Cloud Computing security scenarios through attack trees
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Cloud environments have positioned themselves as one of the most relevant IT management options in today's industry. However, this paradigm is no stranger to the security problems that become more critical as the portfolio of services offered in the cloud is expanded, which means that security incidents in these environments are increasingly critical. This paper presents a proposal for the application of the attack tree methodology for modeling security scenarios in Cloud Computing. For this, a review of risks and countermeasures of the services and infrastructure in the cloud is carried out, to define the elements that make up a Cloud Computing security scenario. As a result, a proposal is presented of the elements from which different attack trees can be modeled that respond to the characteristic risks of the cloud environment. For the scope of this work, the proposal presented was delimited under technical risks, but as a future development, it can be extended to include other types of risks.

articleTitle: Self-repairing asphalt mixing design by heat induction, to control surface faults of heavy traffic in tropical areas of South America
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This research proposes the design of an asphalt mixture that has the property of self-repair, taking as a starting point the design of the conventional asphalt mixture, which incorporates 1 % of polymers and fibers of steel wool, with 1 %, 2 % and 3 % to improve the physical and mechanical behavior of the asphalt mixture and thus find the repair of cracks by heat induction, for this the three-point bending test is performed on the repaired samples to determine the percentage of recovery. The results obtained indicate that, in general, the repair of asphalt mixtures was 50.7% with respect to their initial resistance. In addition, it is observed that metallic aggregates increase the levels of repair of the mixtures and increase the stability in reference to a conventional mixture, being better the results obtained with the asphalt mixture with a lower percentage of steel wool fiber (1 %). If test sections are carried out and this technique is put into practice to see its viability, it is concluded that this technique will provide great potential in pavement maintenance.

articleTitle: Knowledge and information transfer in the Peruvian agricultural sector: A social networking analysis approach
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: In order to break up with old paradigms that diminish the positive impact of innovation in the agricultural sector, it is needed that knowledge transfer becomes an innovator process. In this line, an inclusive approach for knowledge transference process consists of mapping all actors involved in the agricultural sector. The aim of this research is to develop a model from a social network perspective, in order to understand the innovation process through visualization of knowledge and information flows from traditional positions, the small-scale agricultural holdings and the relationship interaction with institutions into the Peruvian Agricultural Innovation System (SNIA by its Spanish initials). Data for this study were collected from the Peruvian Agricultural National Survey (ENA by its Spanish initials) of year 2017. We explore co-attendees interaction, through a two-model affiliation network of farmers who seek agricultural information into the SNIA.

articleTitle: Use of volcanic ash based aggregates for the design of rigid pavements in road projects at 2160 m a.s.l.
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Volcanic ash is a pyroclastic material created by volcanic events. It is composed of small fragments of friable whitish fine-grained siliceous lavas. It can have different degrees of cementation, brittle type, so it can be identified in the category of collapsible soils. This research aims to evaluate the use of marginal aggregates containing volcanic ash for the design of a hydraulic concrete slab, which will be tested with the results of the bending and compression modulus. The results show that fine aggregates without volcanic ash do not comply all the requirements stablished by the Peruvian standard (EG-2013) from the highway manual. However, the American Concrete Institute (ACI) incorporates exceptions for particular conditions of aggregates, making it possible to use them based on compliance with the required strength and durability. The design of a concrete mixture for a theoretical resistance of f'c=280 kg/cm2 was planned. However, when the specimens were tested after 28 days of being cured,an f'c=380 kg/cm2 was obtained. This is because there is a close positive relation between the volcanic ash and the Puzolánic cement used for the mixture.

articleTitle: Automatic Classification Method for Academic Characterization of Computer Programming Students
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Computer programming is a fundamental subject that lays down conceptual basis and tends to develop important abilities for the student's software development path. Nevertheless, in a computer programming course there are several obstacles that prevent students from committing and take computer programming as a professional future or even as a useful tool, this is evidenced in the lack of motivation to learn coding. The difficulties that arise in computer programming's learning process together with the high demand for software developers, highlight the importance to trace the critical fact that influences student's performance and lay down strategies that allow us to improve the possibilities for each student in his learning process. Automatic classification methods are proposed to find patterns to relate personal features with computer programming performance.

articleTitle: Shear strength of a reinforced clayey soil with crushed polyethylene terephthalate
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This article presents the use of plastic bottles of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) as a material for reinforcement in a clayey soil, the PET is used in the form of crushed particles to improve soil resistance. This article presents an experimental study to evaluate the mechanical behavior of pure soil and mixtures with different contents of PET, in order to obtain the strength parameters of the soil-PET mixtures. The clayey soil used was mixed with 5%, 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> and 20% of crushed PET by dry weight. Characterization tests were performed such as particle size distribution, Atterberg limits and the standard compaction test on the samples. Direct Shear tests at vertical stresses of 0.5 kg / cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 1.0 kg / cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 2.0 kg / cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> were done on the soil and mixtures. The results show that the soil strength parameters are influenced by the addition of the crushed PET, since it improves the characteristics of friction angle and cohesion of the Soil-PET mixture. The improvement also depends upon the confining level, which the samples were tested. By comparing the results, show that the mixture with 20% crushed PET stands out against the others, since it has a greater degree of improvement in the soil. These mixtures can be used in geotechnical works, so this research proposes to contribute to a better understanding and interpretation of the behavior of clayey soil reinforced with PET waste.

articleTitle: Integration of health and safety at work in the management of public organizations in Bogotá D.C
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This article intends to identify the contribution of the variable integration of OSH management in the business to measure at maturity of OSH management in public organizations of Bogotá; additionally, the information provided by the variables OSH policies was considered relevant, as well as strategic position and strategic planning. This was done based on the results obtained from the implementation of the maturity instrument that aims to measure the maturity of the Management of Health and Safety at Work (MHSW). The contribution of the variable integration of the management of the OSH to the measurement of the maturity of the management of the OSH was carried out through a confirmatory factor analysis in R Project and an increase was calculated in the average weight assigned to the variable of 10.47% in relation to the initially assigned weight.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the processes to be developed in the infrastructure projects of the Colombian Agricultural Institute ICA
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This article briefly explains the evaluation of the processes to be developed in the infrastructure projects of the Colombian Agricultural Institute ICA. The objective of evaluating the development processes and activities in ICA infrastructure projects seeks to address the recurring problem in public entities which is the lack of organization and deficiencies in the planning and formulation of Projects. In accordance with the above, the proposed solution to this problem is the development and implementation of a process guide applicable to the planning, formulation and control of infrastructure projects, the product of a quantitative and qualitative analysis of the existing procedures.

articleTitle: Proposal of a methodology of project management for sme's of the building sector through the start-up and planning processes of the PMBOK guide
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: The lack of knowledge of the managerial methodologies in the construction companies has produced that some of them do not properly develop the projects in all their groups of processes: start, planning, execution, monitoring and control and closing. For this reason and other factors such as bad accounting of the same and the high costs of taxation, companies have seen themselves affected at an economic and organizational level, having to take drastic measures such as their disappearing. Currently, businessmen don't know about managerial methods for the operation of their companies, ignoring useful methodologies to adequately run their projects. According to the Superintendence of Societies, one of the sectors with high figures of liquidation of companies is the construction. Right there, they report that some of the causes for the liquidation are “the failure or noncompliance of reorganization and restructuring, the abandonment of businesses, the direct request from the debtor or its creditors or court orders”. The construction sector covers many aspects that are relevant and that are very important for the company to function properly. According to “the data of Confecámaras, which includes all the chambers of commerce of the country, there are, approximately, 1,500,000 micro, small and medium enterprises in the Business and Social Single Register - RUES. This figure includes individuals and legal persons. This classification is usually made based on the value of the assets reported by the companies. “[2] Where SMEs represent the largest percentage of all construction companies. Therefore, there is a need to formulate a management method that allows SMEs in the construction sector to carry out their activities in an appropriate manner, using as a reference the start-up and planning processes of the PMBOK guide in its 6th edition. The formulation of the management method based on the PMBOK guide will be done through the preparation of formats and monitoring of activity schedules that could probably solve the managerial problems identified in design and construction companies classified as SMEs.

articleTitle: A Machine for the Pasteurization Process of Tarwi Milk
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This article proposes a machine for the process of pasteurization of Tarwi vegetable milk. The importance of this process lies in achieving a temperature profile that eliminates the greatest amount of pathogens present in milk without drastically reducing its protein concentration. However, this process has not been used in the production of milk based on Tarwi grain. Therefore, the mechanical design calculations were carried out, as well as the construction of the plant to have a milk processing capacity from 10 kilograms of untapped Tarwi. Also, the appropriate controller was selected and tuned to maintain a constant temperature of 75 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes. The tests were carried out with Tarwi milk from a cooking and filtering process at a temperature close to 50 degrees Celsius.

articleTitle: S&OP impact on inventory management in a Peruvian textile company
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises present with a set of problems due to improper supply chain planning; a relevant issue is inadequate inventory management due to poor demand forecasting accuracy. Consequently, this results in difficulties in effectively balancing supply and demand, which in turn means that areas such as purchasing, production, and inventories do not interrelate with one another, resulting in a negative economic impact. The proposal shown in this article is to apply the Sales and Operations Planning tool (S&OP) to a textile company, highlighting its potential impact on the company's inventories.

articleTitle: Integration of CAE Modeling and Artificial Intelligence Systems to Support Manufacturing of Plastic Microparts
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Micrometer-scale parts requirements demand an improvement of the development of the micro-manufacturing industry. This fact is due to current technological advances which require small parts with more complex geometrical characteristics, microparts with more precise dimensional characteristics, microparts with better quality aspect and microparts with improved quality operating characteristics. Therefore, the manufacturing processes to obtain high quality microinjection parts is increasingly complicated, requiring much more time (a greater number of cycles) and knowledge from the expert operator, which makes the process unprofitable, as well as highly dependent of the operator and increasing the final costs of microinjection parts for the user. This paper presents the development of an artificial intelligence system based on the integration of CAE modeling, with fuzzy logic techniques and neural networks techniques to support the operator of the injection machine on the selection of optimal machine process parameters to produce good quality microparts in fewer process cycles. Tests performed with this intelligent integration system development have demonstrated 30% improvement in the efficiency of injection processes.

articleTitle: Evaluation and thermodynamic analysis of a prototype for air heating
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This study aims to improve a prototype solar collector via hot air that had already been used in San Juan de Tarucani, Arequipa; it was moved to Callao, Peru, to perform new tests at different radiation conditions, latitude, altitude, temperature, and humidity. The methodology followed was to perform tests during the month of March, 2019, at 15° and 45° inclination of the collector with respect to the flat surface of the base and measuring temperatures in the air inlet of the collector and in the outlet that enters the “shed.” The results determined that the angle change optimizes the heat input, the relation between radiation and temperature, and the day/night variation.

articleTitle: 5.8 GHz ISM band Yagi-Uda antenna implementation using genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This paper describes the development of a Yagi-Uda antenna, modeled to be used in point-to-point links. The antenna was designed to operate at the 5.8 GHz ISM band (5725 to 5850 MHz). The design and optimization procedure is described by applying genetic algorithms (GA) with the HFSS software. All scheme elements have a diameter of 1/8 inch (about 3.17 mm). Initial design and optimization of a folded dipole was made, then the directors (ten in total) and a reflector were added. The spacing of the elements remains constant, for 0.06λ, 0.1λ, 0.2λ, 0.3λ and 0.4λ, comparisons were made for the estimated gain.

articleTitle: An Electronic Equipment for Automatic Detection of Mycobacteria in MGIT Cultures Based on Digital Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: In this work we propose an automated electronic equipment oriented to the detection of mycobacteria by means of the analysis of fluorescence in MGIT tube cultures using digital image processing. The equipment aims to improve detection efficiency, since this procedure is mostly performed by visual inspection and has low reliability due to subjectivity. Part of the proposed system acts as an incubator for the growth of mycobacteria, which will maintain a temperature of 37°C±1°C. It also has a mobile camera for the acquisition of images of each tube in the enclosure, as well as an algorithm implemented in a single-board computer. The algorithm detects if a tube emits fluorescence, which is an indicator of the presence of mycobacteria in the broth. The steps of the algorithm involve transforming the RGB images to the HSV color model, filtering and classification by K-Nearest Neighbor. Equipment validation was made from a set of samples processed by a medically certified and approved professional electronic equipment. The results were compared with those obtained by the BD Bactec 960 MGIT equipment achieving a Cohen Kappa coefficient of 0.9355 in the evaluation of 40 samples selected by the specialist.

articleTitle: Processes Adaptation under COBIT V5 Reference Framework for Health Sector PYMES
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: The content of this article is the analysis of missionary processes of a chosen company for research, with the aim of reviewing its performance on information systems. The purpose of the project is to adjust the COBIT v5 reference model, based on a goals cascade, so that they focus on their own TI areas' processes, from Small and Medium Enterprises (PYME) of the health sector, reviewing the actual status of PYME taken as a study case, identifying processes, applicable tools and controls, and prioritizing these processes within the government framework. All this, in order to have PYMES of the health sector own a government model available, to allow them the development of actions, focused towards a continuous improvement of the organization, validating procedures for internal processes, and being aligned with the business corporate purpose, and/or making an internal auditing of TI, based on best practices with support and recognition, allowing an appropriate use of technology in the business processes.

articleTitle: Challenges for Joint R&D&I Between University-Industry-Government: Peruvian Case of the Pisco Production
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This paper shows an overview, analysis and reflection on the importance of boosting the relationship between University-Industry-Government to carry out joint R&D&I activities, highlighting international experiences. It shows the case of a prominent productive sector such as the pisco production in Peru. This paper demonstrates the importance and impact of the triple helix to strengthen the development of the regions of the country, impacting society in a measurable way, both in its employment generation processes and in the transfer of knowledge, such as to boost the competitiveness of higher education institutions and companies. Finally, its importance as a strategy of associative, academic-industry and governmental innovation is highlighted, which seeks to generate bonds of trust among the actors involved to promote research, science, innovation and technology in each productive sector of the country.

articleTitle: Optimum location and amount of new Fire Stations based on Geographic Information System and Analytic Hierarchy Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: In this study the Geographic Information System (GIS) method and the Analytical Hierarchical Process (AHP) are combined in order to present a methodology for locating fire stations in cities. Initially, we collect the complete technical information and thus generate a statistical data, from which we derive the attributes of Fire Stations. This methodology evaluates the efficiency of different proposals based on the response time restriction variable, in combination with human perception and the need and experience of firefighters, academics and vulnerable population. The main result is an operational tool that defines the locations and number of stations and the choice of the best alternative considering multiple criteria.

articleTitle: Analysis of compression resistance property of concrete modified with sugarcane (Saccharum Officinarum) bagasse fibers
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: The use of natural fibers as aggregate in concrete mix have been studied more frequently because these provide improvements in the mechanical properties of the concrete and also because it can be considerated as environmentally friendly material since it use agricultural waste such as sugarcane bagasse fiber. In this article, the mechanical behavior of the concrete was analyzed by compression tests and scanning electron microscopy (SEM), the incorporation of sugarcane bagasse fiber was made for standard samples with fiber addition of 0.4%, 0.6% and 0.8%.

articleTitle: Vulnerability studies: a contribution of Colombian engineering for the development ofterritories
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Proper risk management is requisit or territorial development and integrity protection of Colombians, given its high exposure natural events mainly FLOOD ones and torrential floods. These events impact populations such as Pacho (Cundinamarca) and Acacias (Meta), where the assessment of the threat, as well as the vulnerability of its population, constitute a contribution demanded from civil engineering.

articleTitle: Monitoring automation process to improve the evaluation of competency learning for higher education
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This paper proposes a technological solution that automates the action plan monitoring process designed to improve the achievement rate of the learning competence on university students, with the objective of improving the process of evaluation by competencies. Our proposal allows the action plan automated monitoring thanks to a system with features, such as: (1) plan registration through forms with a user experience design, (2) custom dashboards display and download for each level of the action plan or, in general, with all the plans of a specific user for analysis and decision making, (3) loading and downloading of evidence on compliance of the improvement actions, (4) report creation for action plan monitoring in appropriate formats to facilitate reading, and (5) email notifications delivery about any changes to the plan. The proposal is described in two parts: (1) the automation of the monitoring process, (2) the solution functionalities and (3) the designed technological architecture. To validate the proposal, a survey was developed to perform it with functional analysts in a university institution. The results showed that 93.8% of the participants consider that the solution contributes to the improvement of the achievement of competencies, it was also demonstrated that the action plan monitoring is carried out with 99.6% more efficiency, which facilitates compliance with the cost, time and planned impact parameters also contributes to the competency-based evaluation continuous improvement.

articleTitle: Study of Technological Monitoring in Information Systems Audit in Colombia
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: During the year 2019, the Universidad Catolica de Colombia advanced a process of curricular reform of its postgraduate programs at the Faculty of Engineering. For the Information Systems Audit Specialization program, an analysis of trends in research topics was carried out, based on a technological monitoring study using keywords associated with the terms of the program, the opinions of the program coordinator and teachers, with the purpose of defining the curricular areas of the curriculum and training trends at national and international level. The general search equation was developed and the consultation was carried out in the main Scopus collection, giving a result of 363 scientific articles, published between 2010 and 2019. With this information a research exercise was developed using the VantagePoint® software tool through which several reports were generated: the dynamics of publications by years and by countries, the themes associated with the field of knowledge, the correlation between the keywords and the analysis by authors.

articleTitle: Does contextual barriers and supports has an effect on STEM career development? A case study among system engineering students in Peru
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Nowadays, there is a consensus about the importance of science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM). Previous empirical research has found that contextual barriers and supports have the potential to limit or foster the career goals of college students of STEM careers. The aim of the current study was to explore the effects of barriers and supports in self-efficacy, interests, outcome expectations and goals through Social Cognitive Career Theory (SCCT). The participants in this study were 270 system engineering college students from three universities in the North of Lima, Peru. We test causality relationships between barriers and supports and each nuclear component of SCCT. To test direct effects, structural equation modelling was employed. In addition to these, we established different types of barriers and support in the current sample. Therefore, the present study may help educational institutions and policymakers to develop specific systematic strategies for system engineers such as career orientation, academic skills training, counselling, and psychological services.

articleTitle: Improvement to the design of underground blasting in a metallurgical carbon mining of the Carbonapoles mine, located in the municipality of Samacá, Boyacá
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: An improvement was made to the blasting system that is carried out within the facilities of the Carbonapoles mine, located in the municipality of Samacá Boyacá. Under the foundations and method of Calvin J. Konya, key parameters of underground blasting were estimated, such as burden, spacing, stemming and rigidity index; simultaneously applying geological correction of the behavior and structure of the rocky massif to some of these. Other parameters involved in this blasting system are the density of the explosive and the diameter of the borehole. The previous criteria allows for the standardization of blasting techniques and to change the empirical methods of the miner in charge of handling explosives in this line of work.

articleTitle: Prospective integration between Environmental Intelligence (AMI), Data Analytics (DA), and Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: This article presents the results of an investigation and analysis of information on emerging technologies to achieve two purposes. The first purpose is to create three reference models: IOT reference model, AMI reference model and DA reference model, applicable for the implementation of solutions to different real-life problems. The second purpose is to present the proposal of a single integrated reference model, called Quysqua, which synergistically combines the three models mentioned above.

articleTitle: Calculation of explosives optimal load to achieve the economic trituration of concrete and demolition waste (CDW) ISBN 978-1-7281-4746-8
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Two years ago, Resolution 472 of February 28, 2017 urging the use of recycled materials in civil works and concrete structures in all over the city of Bogotá, to counteract the use of aggregates from natural sources and encourage practices that promote the environment conservation. The main goal of this study is to encourage the use of explosives in demolitions by studying the granulometries through the optimization of explosive load factor to be competitive in the cost structure of the crushing of concrete and demolition waste (CDW). Starts with a little research of the market structure of natural sources aggregates in the city and its comparison with the use of is currently considered. Then, by means of 2 types of concrete samples of 4000 psi of resistance that simulate beam and column structures respectively, are detonated with 4 different doses of indugel. The mechanism to predict the theoretical granulometry, the type of explosive and the dosage of each of the samples is done through the Kuz-Ram fragmentation model, which is compared with the granulometries obtained from 8 detonations in total. Finally, by conservative decisions with peak particle velocity, technically efficient with the use of indugel and consistent with the desired size for the economic efficiency crushing required, a load factor of 1kg / m3 is obtained for beams and 1.2 kg / m3 for columns.

articleTitle: Seismic analysis with viscous dampers for the protection of schools in seismic zone
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: In the present study, we analyze low-rise structures with and without the use of viscous dampers to use this system as a measure of seismic protection in existing educational buildings, generally composed of several pavilions of two or three levels. These educational premises have been built in the coastal area of South America with seismic-resistant standards whose validity is outdated, so they are vulnerable to serious damage, such as masonry wall failures and short columns. The situation is further aggravated by considering the continuous earthquakes in the region caused by contact between the Nazca and South American plates. This research is formulated under the guidelines of the FEMA 273-274 and the SEAOC through the Vision 2000 Committee. The research is validated by computer models of educational buildings, in which the location will be proposed and the properties of viscous dampers to reinforce school premises, thus improving their seismic performance. The results are favorable, with a reduction in drifts and seismic forces, greater than 56%.

articleTitle: Multi-criteria Decision Making Model for Vulnerabilities Assessment in Cloud Computing regarding Common Vulnerability Scoring System
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: Vulnerability is associated with the probability of resistance of actions of a threat. A vulnerability exists when a force of threat exceeds the capacity of resistance. Virtualization and its exclusive architecture have numerous features and advantages over non-conventional virtual machines. However, this new uniqueness creates new vulnerabilities and attacks on a cloud system. Assessing the security of software services on Cloud is complex because the security depends on the vulnerability of infrastructure, platform and software services. In 2017, over 14,000 new vulnerabilities were disclosed, so, a key question for administrators is which vulnerabilities to prioritize. The Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) is often used to decide which vulnerabilities pose the greatest risk. CVSS V3 creates a metric for each vulnerability and establishes a very broad definition of vulnerabilities, therefore, multi-criteria decision making (MCDM) is necessary to making a choice of the best alternative from among a finite set of decision alternatives in terms of multiple criteria. We propose a model for the evaluation and prioritization of vulnerabilities in cloud architectures based on the Common Vulnerability Scoring System and multi-criteria decision making.

articleTitle: Design of theoretical dimensions for a knowledge management model applied to the Colombian Swine Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: The Colombian Swine Industry (CSI) market is managed by importers, technified pig farmers, and small pig producers. CSI is important for agriculture due to sustainable objectives. CSI wants to encourage profitability in order to enter new markets and satisfy local demand. One of the strategies proposed in this research is capitalization of Knowledge Management (KM) since pig's production cycle is relatively short and it encourages the return of investment for Colombian farmers. However, small pig farmers have many limitations due to the lack of technology, high production cost, lack of resources, and production and training incentives, those are main issues to encourage pork commercialization along with quality, biosecurity, and traceability. This article aims to identify the dimensions, subdimensions, and variables for competitiveness and KM that exist in the literature and have been applied to the Swine Industry (SI) to identify and incentivize CSI profitability. Firstly, to design those theoretical dimensions, subdimensions, and variables proposed for competitiveness and KM in CSI, 90 articles were reviewed; they were classified, analyzed and consolidated. Among the most outstanding results, to measure the global pig industry (GPI) competitiveness, authors have focused on costs, revenues, and traceability which have been determined on the literature as environmental, profitability and Supply Chain (SC) design and management in SI. Secondly, this research complements the literature in designing KM dimensions, sub-dimensions, and variables to measure SI profitability. Six competitiveness dimensions proposed in this research were constructed from the literature: environment, SC design and management, cost-effectiveness, quality management, human resource management, and innovation management; and KM dimensions for agglomerations are four: profitability, SC design and management, KM capacity and innovation, and agglomeration performance. The research perspective is the validation of the dimensions in other industries.

articleTitle: Methodology of Neuromarketing in Websites Analysis Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingenieria (CONIITI )
abstract: According to Salesforce of 6,421 customers who bought Web pages during 2016 at the end of 2017, only 2,917 remained, corresponding to a 54<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> decrease. When tracking 850 clients to know the causes of dissatisfaction with the product of Web pages, it was found that 35.92% of the clients surveyed indicated that the design of their website was not appropriate for their business, this fact allowed to identify a set of possible elements or factors that cause the failure of the web pages, as: not identify potential clients, not identify the final objective, web pages without Consistency, think that appearance is the only thing that matters and optimize before getting traffic.
